name: Potato Latkes with Smoked Salmon, Yogurt, Dill & Celery-Apple Salad

instructions.primary_message: Wash and dry the fresh produce. (Skip the arugula if it came pre-washed.)
instructions.secondary_message:
1 small bunch fresh dill
6 medium yellow potatoes
3 Granny Smith apples
6 sticks celery
1 ½ (142 g) pkg baby arugula

instructions.primary_message: Place eggs, bread crumbs, cornstarch, salt, and pepper in a large bowl; whisk to combine the egg mixture.
instructions.secondary_message:
6 eggs
¾ cup panko bread crumbs
2 tbsp cornstarch
1 ½ tsp salt
¾ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Using a knife, shave dill leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves. Add dill to the bowl with the egg mixture (reserving a small handful for garnish).
Peel potatoes; using a box grater, coarsely grate, and place in a colander. Using your hands, squeeze as much water from the potato as you can.
Add grated potato to the bowl with the egg mixture and use your hands to thoroughly combine the latke mixture.
Using a ⅓-cup measure, form the latke mixture into ½-inch thick patties; place on a large baking sheet pan.
Preheat a large skillet over medium heat.

Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Working in batches, add patties and cook until golden brown and cooked through, 4-5 minutes per side. Remove latkes to a paper towel-lined plate, placing additional paper towels between layers to soak up excess oil.
instructions.secondary_message: ⅓ cup extra virgin olive oil

instructions.primary_message: Meanwhile, place oil, vinegar, Dijon, honey, and salt in another large bowl; whisk to combine the dressing.
instructions.secondary_message:
2 tbsp extra virgin olive oil
2 tbsp apple cider vinegar
1 tbsp Dijon mustard
1 ½ tsp honey
½ tsp salt

instructions.primary_message: Quarter, core, and thinly slice apples; add to the bowl with the dressing.
Trim and slice celery crosswise into thin pieces; add to the bowl.
Chop or tear salmon into bite-sized pieces.
Just before serving, add arugula to the bowl and toss to combine the salad.
Divide latkes between plates and season with pepper; top with salmon, yogurt, and reserved dill. Serve with salad on the side and enjoy!
instructions.secondary_message:
3 pinch black pepper
1 cup plain Greek yogurt
